evidence.quote: But how will others access, run, and explore them?
Run: To support others running your notebooks, you can use Binder [ 16 ] to provide a zero-install environment to run your notebooks in the cloud ( https://mybinder.org/ ).

More generally, you can create a portable containerized environment, for example, a Docker image ( https://docs.docker.com/ ), or create a dependency description file (see Rule 3 ) so future users of your notebook can more easily replicate your computing environment when rerunning your notebook.
